title: Holistic workload profiler and safe batch-parameter orchestrator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a recommender service that produces safe, workload-aware batching and caching parameter proposals. The engine will profile live and historical traffic to create compact workload fingerprints, evaluate heuristics and simulated outcomes for candidate configs, and surface a ranked set of suggested continuous batching parameters (eg. max_batch_size, max_delay_ms, batching_window_policy, prefix_cache_ttl, kv_cache_aggressiveness). It must include a safe apply flow: dry-run simulation, canary apply to a small percentage of traffic, automated rollback triggers based on tail-latency and error-rate guards, and audit logging for every change. The goal is to reduce token-per-second cost for typical web-scale workloads by 10-30% while preserving P99 latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Profiler can generate a 32-byte fingerprint and assign a stable workload_id for a workload within 5 minutes of observed traffic
Recommender outputs top-3 config proposals with estimated cost delta and simulated latency impact for each proposal
Safe-apply pipeline supports dry-run simulation, staged canary (0.5% -> 5% -> 20%), and automatic rollback if P99 latency increases by >10% or error-rate increases by >1%
End-to-end integration tests that simulate bursty and long-tail traffic show no regression to P99 latency in 95% of trials
Console shows per-workload recommendation history, auditable diffs, and the reason-score breakdown (cache benefit, batching benefit, risk score)

notes: Implementation phases: 1) Profiler service + fingerprint store, 2) Simulator + heuristic scoring, 3) Safe-apply pipeline + rollback automation, 4) Console surface and audit logging
Heuristic scoring should combine cost_savings_score, risk_score, cache_conflict_penalty, and rollout_complexity. Use weighted sum with tunable weights per account tier.

Simulator must be able to replay traces with KV cache model and batching queuing model (continuous batching params like max_wait_ms, max_batch_tokens). Keep simulator deterministic and fast for dry runs.
Plan to add a shadow mode where recommendations run for 48h on live traffic without changing behavior, collecting real delta metrics before applying canary.

Deliverable: public PRD with conservative defaults and operator override, plus a migration guide for Dedicated customers to opt-in to automated recommendations. Link to PRD (confluence): https://confluence.redwood/AutoBatch/PRD-v1
